_comment: Reference sources approved for the on-phone guide. Factual sources (cross-references, places, dictionaries, topical index) were approved 2026-11-23 on the coordinator's technical decision. Matthew Henry and Wesley's commentaries were approved 2026-11-23 on Levi's answer A: both are used, each excerpt labelled with author and tradition, and Perazim's own view always comes first. Commentaries ship as an optional download, not in the default install. Creeds: the Nicene-Constantinopolitan Creed of 381 was approved by Levi on 2026-11-23 (his answer A). Its text is in scripts/reference/creeds/ and is built into the default reference database. The other creeds and confessions are NOT listed. Each commentary and factual id must match a sources row in scripts/reference/sources.json. Lexicon ids (bdb-openscriptures, step-tbesg, step-tbesh) were approved for evidence only on Levi's answer of 2026-11-28, after his 2026-11-27 decisions Q1 to Q7. Their licences and pending permissions are in assets/reference/lexicon-core.manifest.json. TBESH needs Online Bible permission and the ESV name forms need a STEP Bible check; both are recorded there and removed by the --release build.
